clips.title: The story
paras: Jarven Thunderbrew watches the cellar stores at Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Forbidden to touch the barrels, he asks a passing traveler to bring him a mug of Thunder Ale from upstairs, hoping it will sharpen his wits on duty.

In Kharanos, Jarven Thunderbrew keeps watch over the deep stores of Thunderbrew Distillery. His family forbids him to drink from the stock while on guard, though the finest stout in Dun Morogh surrounds him. The temptation wins out, and he asks passing travelers to fetch a pint of potent Thunder Ale from the taps upstairs.

Jarven says a good drink will hone his senses and strengthen his watch. Whether a guard should drink on duty remains an open question. Few hardy dwarves in Dun Morogh can fault a Thunderbrew for wanting a taste of the brew made by his own kin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
